annotations.text:
THE INDEX — the page behaves like a living card catalogue.
· One idea everywhere: nothing floats, everything is filed. Hairline rules instead of cards, sharp rectangles instead of pills, aubergine used as ink.
· Two voices: Ysabeau at monumental weight for statements; Fragment Mono (the house mono) for every fact — numbers, deadlines, fees, classifications.
· Motion is the catalogue working: the classification ticker drifts, the index rail files entries past continuously, rules draw themselves in, margin notes stamp [ → FILED ], the verification stamp lands on the record card.
· Rail and table rows are schematic here and labeled as such; in the app they are fed by the live published Opportunities.

Implementation notes: Ysabeau and Fragment Mono are already the app fonts (next/font local). Table = real semantic table fed by the repository browse; rail = live entries. All motion CSS-only; reduced motion stops the ticker and rail and shows settled states.
